title: QC-ABOUT-002 — Chairman's Message

QC-ABOUT-002 — Chairman's
Message
FRONTEND — Visitor Display
User Story ID
QC-ABOUT-002 | US-001 | REF:
FR-006
Title
Chairman's Message — Visitor
Display
As a
public website visitor
I want
to access and read the Chairman's
Message on the Qatar Chamber website
So that
I can view the strategic vision
and leadership communication from the Chairman
Preconditions:
- The Qatar Chamber website is published and accessible.
- The Chairman's Message page content is published in the CMS.
Frontend Workflow:
- Public Visitor navigates to Main Menu → About Us → Chairman's Message.
- The page loads with a full-width Hero Banner displaying the image with a dark overlay, the Page Title ("Chairman's Message") overlaid in white, and breadcrumb navigation ("Home > About Us").
- Below the Hero Banner, the page renders in a two-column layout:
- Left column: Chairman portrait photo displayed with a decorative maroon background element. Below the portrait, a styled Name Card displays the Chairman's Name (bold, maroon) and Designation (e.g. "Chairman of The Board").
- Right column: Message content — a styled salutation heading (e.g. "Dear members and visitors") followed by body paragraphs in rich text.
- At the bottom of the right column, a styled Signature/Closing block is displayed showing a circular icon, "Best Regards,", Chairman Name (maroon), and Designation — populated from the configured Name and Designation fields.
- Public Visitor scrolls through the page content and reads the message.
- Public Visitor may click any configured hyperlink within the content where available.
Given the visitor opens the Chairman's Message page
When the page renders
Then:
- the system shall display the Hero Banner with the configured background image, dark overlay, Page Title, and breadcrumb.
- the Chairman portrait shall be displayed in the left column with the decorative background element.
- the Name Card below the portrait shall display the Chairman Name and Designation as configured.
- the right column shall display the salutation heading and message body as rich text.
- the Signature/Closing block at the bottom of the message shall display "Best Regards,", Chairman Name, and Designation — sourced from the configured Name and Designation fields.
- rich text shall support headings, paragraphs, bullets, and inline links.
- Images shall display with the configured alt text for accessibility.
- hyperlinks shall be CMS-configurable and follow the approved open behaviour (same or new tab).
- only published content shall appear on the website.
- the page shall render correctly in both LTR (EN) and RTL (AR) layouts.
Edge Case Scenarios:
- If translation is missing for the selected language, the system shall fall back to the configured default language.
Negative Scenarios:
- Draft content shall remain visible only in CMS and shall not appear on the website.
Post Condition:
Visitor can read the Chairman's Message and access any configured hyperlinks
BACKEND — Admin CMS Management
User Story ID
QC-ABOUT-002 | US-002 | REF:
FR-006
Title
Chairman's Message — CMS
Management
As a
authorized admin user (Site
Content Editor / Site Content Author)
I want
to create, edit, and publish the
Chairman's Message page content including bilingual text, portrait image, and
hyperlinks
So that
visitors can read the latest
Chairman's Message on the Qatar Chamber website
Preconditions:
- Admin has Site Content Editor or Site Content Author role in Liferay CMS.
- Chairman's Message page record is accessible in the CMS.
Administrator Workflow:
- Site Content Editor or Site Content Author logs into Liferay CMS.
- Opens the Chairman's Message page record.
- Uploads or replaces the Hero Banner background image and sets alt text (EN + AR).
- Creates or updates Page Title (EN + AR).
- Uploads or replaces the Chairman Portrait image and sets alt text (EN + AR).
- Enters or updates Chairman Name (EN + AR) and Chairman Designation (EN + AR) — these populate both the Name Card below the portrait and the Signature/Closing block.
- Creates or updates Message Content (EN + AR) including salutation heading and body paragraphs.
- Manages hyperlinks within the message content (add, edit, remove) where permitted.
- Saves content as draft or previews it.
- Publishes the page.
- System saves and displays a Liferay generic success toast message (EN + AR).
- Published content reflects on the frontend after cache refresh.
Given the admin opens the Chairman's Message page record in CMS
When the admin updates and publishes the content
Then:
- the system shall allow the admin to create, edit, preview, publish, and unpublish the page where permitted.
- Site Content Author shall be able to view and update assigned page content where permitted.
- the system shall validate image format (JPG, PNG), image size (max 2 MB), content length, and URL format before save or publish.
- the system shall support draft → preview → publish → unpublish lifecycle.
- the system shall display a Liferay generic success toast message after each successful action (EN + AR).
- only published content shall appear on the website; draft content remains visible only in CMS.
- CMS stores updated content, updates page cache, and records the change in the audit log.
- Chairman Name and Designation fields shall auto-populate the Name Card (below portrait) and the Signature/Closing block on the frontend.
Edge Case Scenarios:
- If Arabic title is missing and Arabic language is enabled: "Arabic title is required." | العنوان العربي مطلوب.
- If image size exceeds 2 MB: "Image size must not exceed 2 MB." | يجب ألا يتجاوز حجم الصورة 2 ميغابايت.
- If image format is invalid: "Image must be JPG or PNG." | يجب أن تكون الصورة بتنسيق JPG أو PNG.
Negative Scenarios:
- If the admin lacks permission: "Access Denied. You do not have permission to perform this action." | تم رفض الوصول. ليس لديك صلاحية لتنفيذ هذا الإجراء.
Post Condition:
Chairman's Message is published and visible on the website. Audit log records the change.

Permissions:
- Site Content Editor (Site Role): Create, Edit, View, Preview, Publish, Unpublish page content where permitted.
- Site Content Author (Site Role): View and update assigned page content where permitted.
- Public Visitor: View published page content.
Business Rules:
- Only Published content appears on the website.
- Draft content remains visible only in CMS.
- Chairman Name and Designation fields are single-source — they auto-populate both the Name Card (below portrait) and the Signature/Closing block on the frontend. No duplicate data entry required.
- All images must include alt text for accessibility.
Admin Toast Messages: Use Liferay Generic
Messages (EN + AR).
